Introduction
This report will explain how the hybrid hotel (hybrids) segment of the hospitality industry can navigate the disruption of Covid-19 to emerge in a stronger position than traditional hotel models (hotels) and disrupters like Airbnb.
Hybrids combine value drivers from both hotels and hostels, with a focus on delivering social experiences and using space creatively (Folgado, 2020). They are well-placed to capitalise on shifting consumer attitudes. Additionally, the pandemic has exposed the risk incumbents have taken by providing a one-dimensional offering. Awareness of the need for revenue diversification has become more colloquial, and the hybrid model addresses this need.

Reading Notes
Some managers have failed to distinguish between operational effectiveness and strategy; OE is a necessary but insufficient condition
OE is performing similar activities better than rivals
Strategy involves performing different activities, or similar activities in different ways
OE is insufficient because of the rapid diffusion of best practices and the fact that OE’s productivity gains are often captured by suppliers and consumers (thus no change in profitability)
Additionally, competitive convergence occurs as rivals outsource activities to third parties, hence these activities become more generic (Porter)
Competitive strategy rests on unique activities i.e. tailoring activities to the needs of a customer segment to achieve a unique and valuable strategic position
Origins of strategic positions:
Variety-based positioning: specialise a subset of a market’s good or service

Strategic brand management decisions
Brand management uses the implementation of marketing mix to build, measure and manage brand value (35). Strategic brand management is providing an offering with an identity understood on all levels. Includes a focus on people, both internally and externally.
Strategic brand management increases corporate success; 80% of companies managed with a strong brand focus had operating profits twice as high as the sector average (36, Booz Allen Hamilton).
Important to have a brand vision that offers a clear and consistent message about the value of the brand. Brand equity is the value of the brand to the company. Brand equity increases if the right marketing processes are put in place.
